# Benchmark corpus

Item 1A, Risk Factors, from NVIDIA's FY2025 Form 10-K, accession
`0001045810-25-000023`, read from `www.sec.gov`. SEC filings are public domain.
The paragraphs are verbatim; the section headings are the filing's own risk
headings, lightly shortened.

Risk Factors is the densest section of a filing for this taxonomy — it names
products, geographies, other companies, supply constraints and strategies in
tight prose — and it is where a missed entity matters most, because it is where
the company writes down what could go wrong.

Sixteen subsections, so the chunker produces a benchmark-sized run rather than
a whole filing. This is the corpus the extraction numbers are measured against;
changing it invalidates comparison with earlier runs, so add sections rather
than editing these.
